### Step 1 — Scene
A light meal consisting of mixed green salad, a glass of orange juice, and a wrapped bar that appears to be a chocolate-coated ice cream bar. The wrapped item’s identity and size are uncertain.

### Step 2 — Vessel
The salad is in a shallow bowl approximately **19 cm in diameter**.
Vessel area = 3.14 × 9.5² ≈ **283 cm²**. The drink and wrapped bar are assessed separately.

### Steps 3–6 — Items, area, volume, and weight
Salad components are assigned non-overlapping projected areas; together they cover approximately **88%** of the bowl.

| Item | Bowl area | Area × typical height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed leafy greens | 55% | 156 cm² × 1.8 cm = 281 ml | 0.15 g/ml | 42 g |
| Cucumber pieces | 18% | 51 cm² × 1 cm = 51 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 31 g |
| Cherry tomato pieces | 12% | 34 cm² × 1.2 cm = 41 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 25 g |
| Shredded carrot | 3% | 8.5 cm² × 0.6 cm = 5 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 3 g |

No separate dressing or oil is clearly distinguishable, so none is added.

- **Orange juice:** visible liquid volume approximately 220 ml × 1.04 g/ml ≈ **229 g**.
- **Wrapped bar:** assuming chocolate-coated ice cream, an approximately 110 ml edible envelope × 0.77 g/ml ≈ **85 g**, excluding packaging.

### Step 7 — Energy

| Mixed leafy greens | 20 | 8 |
| Cucumber | 15 | 5 |
| Cherry tomatoes | 18 | 5 |
| Carrot | 41 | 1 |
| Orange juice | 45 | 103 |
| Chocolate-coated ice cream bar | 310 | 264 |

### Step 8 — Sanity check
The salad totals approximately **101 g**, plausible for a loose, leafy side salad. Including the juice and assumed ice cream bar, the meal is approximately **415 g and 386 kcal**. The wrapped bar is the largest source of uncertainty.
